title: Regular Expression Matching - Solution
intuition: Implement regular expression matching with support for '.' and '*'.
step_by_step_explanation: Iterate through elements and apply logic accordingly.
common_mistakes: Use 2D DP. If pattern has '*', it can match 0 occurrences (dp[i][j-2]) or 1+ occurrences if preceding char matches (dp[i-1][j]).
